label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Word-of-Mouth Marketing
body: This is when happy customers tell others about your product or service because they genuinely like it.
caption:
Think about how you found your favorite local coffee shop or a handy new app. Chances are, someone you know mentioned it to you. When your customers share their positive experiences with friends, family, or colleagues, it creates authentic recommendations that can help more people discover what you offer. Focusing on delivering great value and service encourages this natural sharing.
